content.text:
Checked the letter against the fact sheet for the YTD point.

**Finding:** The letter's performance paragraph covers the Q2 net return (-2.4%), Q2 gross (-2.2%), the benchmark (-1.6%), and since-inception annualized (5.9%) — but it skips the year-to-date figure entirely. There is no statement of performance through June 30 on a YTD basis anywhere in the letter, so the -0.7% figure never reaches the client.

points.evidence: The letter's performance paragraph reports only: "your account returned -2.4% net of fees (the gross-of-fees return was -2.2%). For comparison, the benchmark index returned -1.6% during the same period. Since the inception of your strategy on January 2, 2020, the account has achieved an annualized return of 5.9% net of fees." The year-to-date through June 30, 2026 net return of -0.7% is omitted; no YTD figure appears anywhere in the letter.
